verdict.rationale: FireHydrant docs show concrete integrations with Slack (incident channels, slash commands, AI summaries available to non-users, notifications), Jira (auto-created tickets), and Zoom (meeting bridges, AI-captured chat insights, Scribe transcription), plus generic webhooks/API for custom bidirectional sync to any external system. However, Microsoft Teams and GitHub are never explicitly named in the evidence, and no example shows state flowing back from these tools (e.g., Jira ticket status syncing back into FireHydrant) beyond outbound automation. Missing for 10: explicit GitHub integration evidence, explicit Teams integration evidence, and documented two-way state sync (not just push automation) for Jira/Slack.
